summary: Official MLHCP, OARG, and NLC pages evidence Sierra Leone land-registration/cadastral custodians and procedures, but bounded anonymous requests found no public Bo parcel geometry, stable parcel identity, schema, CRS, or viewer/API route. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Krio-oriented first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-1027-bo.json. They found official land-registration, cadastral-survey, GIS/NLIS, and LMIS pages, but no public parcel layer.
requestOutcomes: Anonymous TLS-verified GETs fetched MLHCP portal pages, MLHCP GIS page, NLC digital portal, and NMA mining-cadastre page; NLC /api returned 404 and OARG land-register returned 500. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, formal submission, or unsafe property lookup was used.
scopeLimits: Official custodian/procedure pages establish a registry and survey route, not public parcel geometry availability or Bo coverage.
The MLHCP/NLC digital land-information systems are described as application-based or under development; no public JavaScript/configuration endpoint was exposed.
The NMA mining cadastre is a separate mineral-rights source and was not treated as a general land-parcel source.
No exact-point hit or miss, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unavailable UI was treated as evidence of citywide cadastral absence, and the WUP point was not shifted.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel geometry and identity response was obtained.
This packet is research evidence only and must not be treated as source integration or adapter admission.
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; do not synthesize one from directory rows, search results, response order, or internal records.
crs: unverified; no parcel geometry response obtained
geometryQuality: not evaluated; no parcel geometry retained
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: A restricted, account-gated, formal-request, or not-yet-published cadastral service may exist. Public availability, parcel schema, CRS, native identity, coverage, and safe anonymous runtime access remain unresolved.
